Why Secfix exists

Over 1.78 million SMBs in Europe need to comply with security frameworks — ISO 27001, GDPR, TISAX, SOC 2 — just to sell to enterprise customers. The process is manual, painful, and takes over a year. We automated it.

Our platform integrates with a company's full tech stack — AWS, Azure AD, Jira, GitLab, GCP, and more — automatically extracts compliance evidence, and guides teams to certification in weeks instead of months. Our fastest customer was certified in 4 weeks instead of the industry-standard 12+ months.

We've raised €17M in total (€12M Series A), backed by Alstin Capital, Neosfer (Commerzbank), and Bayern Capital. We're on a profitable trajectory, growing fast, and building the team that will take us to own European market from SMBs to mid market.

This space is not threatened by AI; it's amplified by it. Compliance requires deep domain expertise combined with automation. What you'll actually do in the first 3 months

This isn't a role where you show up and start running standups. There are no standups. Here's how the first quarter goes:

Month 1: Ship. Get into the codebase and ship a meaningful feature with AI alongside the team. By the end of the month, the team should be bringing you their hardest technical questions — because you've earned it, not because of the title.

Month 2: Make the team faster. Find where features take three weeks that should take one, and fix it — in tooling, in how we review and test, or in who's working on what. Month 3: Own technical hiring. Take over the technical interviews and build a process that runs without my oversight. Design the technical challenges, run the screens, make the calls. The next people we bring in should raise the pace again. I will be there but switch my focus to final interviews.

  • Focus is sacred. Engineers are in fewer than 2 hours of meetings per week. We write before we meet. Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role:

Let's be honest: 2026 is a strange time to be in Talent Acquisition. Most recruiters are currently looking at their own internal dashboards with a sense of unease. They're seeing the pivots, the shrinking req loads, and the 'doing more with less' memos. If you're currently at a startup that's struggling to find its footing, or a business where the hiring bar has dropped just to fill seats, you know exactly how fragile that 'growth' story feels.

Samsara is the exception. We are a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $2B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. 

And we aren't just stable—we're expanding. Our UK Mid-Market team grew 70% year-over-year last year, and we need the talent engine to match that velocity. We aren't looking for someone to manage inbounds; we're looking for a recruiter who wants to move from a shaky seat into a high-conviction, high-growth environment where the fundamentals actually make sense.

The Challenge:

  • Self-Sourced: You own your destiny. You will be expected to find, engage, and convert your own pipeline using best-in-class tools like HireEZ, Juicebox, and LinkedIn Recruiter.
  • The High Talent Bar: We aren't looking for CV pushers. You will be expected to act as a rigorous gatekeeper, ensuring that only the top 1% of gritty, A player sales hunters make it into our process.
  • Technical Assessment: You aren't checking vibes. You will be conducting deep-dive sales assessments, evaluating discovery mechanics, and ensuring every candidate has a structured methodology for success.

In this role, you will:

  • Execute & Deliver: Your mission is to fuel the Sales Account Executive engine. You will deliver high-quality, targeted pipelines at pace across EMEA, including the UK, France, Germany, and the Netherlands.
  • Own the Data: You are the CEO of your funnel. You will have total ownership of your response rates, passthrough rates, and talent market mapping. We make decisions based on data, not gut feel.
  • Partner with Sales Heavyweights: Work directly with our Sales VP and GTM leaders to align on hiring strategies that move the needle. You are a consultant, not an order-taker.
  • Master the Craft of Strategic Talent Acquisition: We hire for execution but develop for mastery. You will be mentored by some of the most sophisticated talent leaders in SaaS, learning how to move beyond execution to becoming a strategic talent partner who can influence the trajectory of an entire region.

Strong Backgrounds successful in this role:

  • The Agency Foundation: You started your career in a fast-paced recruiting agency. You still have that hunter DNA and the resilience to handle a relentless quarterly pace.
  • In-House Impact: In-house SaaS sales recruiting experience within a high-talent bar GTM organisation. You've proven you can translate agency grit into internal success.
  • EMEA Experience: You've successfully closed reqs in the UK and at least one other European market.
  • Technical Acumen: You can speak the language of sales. You know the difference between an order-taker and a territory owner. You have experience hiring for a scaling playbook environment and understand how to identify the elite within this market from the B players. 

The Ideal Candidate is:

  • Foundational Mastery: The goal is to bridge the gap between execution and influence. You are here to build the bulletproof foundations of an exceptional recruiter—learning how to own a region, influence high-level stakeholders, and use data as a weapon.
  • Focused & Structured: You understand that structuring your inputs—sourcing volume, message personalization, and rigorous screening—is the only way to get consistent output.
  • Data-Minded: You study your own conversion rates and market talent availability to stay ahead of hiring needs.
  • Continuous Process Iteration: You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You iterate on your outreach and your screening questions based on what the data tells you.

What's in it for you?

  • Build the Foundation for Leadership: We believe leadership is a set of skills, not just a job title. In this role, you will develop the data literacy to lead a boardroom with metrics, the strategic insight to advise VPs on market conditions, and the technical acumen to assess elite GTM talent.
  • Elite Exposure: You will be exposed to a broad range of international roles and learn from some of the best sales and recruiting leaders in the industry.
  • The Fortress Stability: NYSE-listed, GAAP profitable, and essential to the global economy. We are building for the long term, which means your career development here is backed by real revenue, not just a VC's hopes.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. TL;DR

You know how to walk into an enterprise, spot the pain points in its ERP processes, and see what good could look like. At Conduct you turn that into a game changing moment: you show leadership, with confidence, how Conduct will transform the way they run SAP. You own optimising the delivery of transformation projects with Conduct, from the first use case to adoption across the business. You build the trust that turns a pilot into a long-term partnership, and the product insights you bring back directly shape what we build next.

Why Conduct

The world's largest companies should move at the speed of their ideas, not the speed of the systems they run on. Today they don't, and you've seen why firsthand.

Every new product line, pricing change or process redesign runs into SAP estates layered with decades of custom code, user exits and enhancements no single person fully understands. Requirements take months to ship. S/4HANA migrations cost $100M+ and years of pain, and the 2027 ECC deadline is forcing every large enterprise to face it.

We're building the AI operating system that absorbs this complexity and gives enterprises back their speed. Major enterprises already trust us with their most critical systems. We've closed game-changing SI partnerships, just raised a $60M Series A, and demand is outpacing what we can service.

We're a small, talent-dense team doing our life's work out of London and NYC. Extreme ownership, high velocity, low-ego collaboration. What you build here shapes the company and how the world's largest companies operate. We sponsor visas and are convinced diverse teams build better products, so we especially encourage underrepresented groups in tech to reach out.

What you'll own

You will make sure Conduct lands and sticks inside our most strategic SAP customers. You join accounts early, shape how Conduct fits into their transformation programmes, and fully take over post-sale. You'll have a direct line from what you see in the field to what ships in the product.

  • Be the SAP brain in the room. Translate between CIOs, process owners, Basis teams and our engineers. Scope use cases across finance, supply chain, procurement and sales that land real value fast.

  • Design the transformation. Get under the skin of complex, heavily customised ECC and S/4HANA landscapes. Conceptualise where Conduct can have the biggest impact, then lead the deployment that gets the customer there.

  • Turn pilots into partnerships. Onboard hundreds of end users, prove ROI, spot expansion signals and hold the early commercial conversations that grow an account.

  • Shape the product. You'll have a direct line into product and engineering. Your view of how SAP actually runs in the real world will shape our roadmap.

  • Build the engine. Our GTM team is small and lean. You'll build the onboarding flows, tooling and reusable playbooks that let customer capacity compound without headcount growing linearly.

  • Work with our SI partners. You speak their language. Help partners deploy Conduct inside their own programmes.

No two days look the same. You'll fly out to customers when it counts and spend the rest of the time building alongside the team.

Who we hire

We're looking for people obsessed with delivering for customers. You'll fit right in if former colleagues would, without hesitating, call you one of the sharpest people they've worked with.

In practice that tends to look like:

  • 3+ years in SAP or ERP consulting, at a Big Four firm, a global SI or a specialist SAP partner. You've been on live implementations, rollouts or S/4HANA transformations, not just advisory.

  • Real depth in at least one area of SAP. Functional (FI/CO, SD, MM, PP, EWM), technical (ABAP, integration, BTP) or solution architecture. You understand how processes and custom code fit together across the landscape.

  • Client-facing confidence. You've run workshops, owned a workstream and earned the trust of senior stakeholders who were sceptical at first.

  • Commercial instinct. You notice the next problem worth solving, and you understand that a great deployment is how accounts grow.

  • Builder energy. You want to do the hands-on customer work and build the process behind it. Ambiguity excites you more than it worries you.

  • Curiosity about AI. You don't need to be an engineer. You do need to want to learn how it works and where it breaks.

  • Low ego, high self-awareness. You're comfortable saying "I don't know" in a complex technical room, then going and figuring it out.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We care more about trajectory and sharpness than a perfect match.

And we care about revenue, not vanity metrics.</p> <p><strong>Who will thrive here</strong></p> <p>Someone who would rather build a working prototype than spend a week debating a roadmap. Someone who notices a broken onboarding experience and immediately starts fixing it. Someone who understands both what makes infrastructure technically excellent and what makes developers want to use it.</p> <p>You should be capable of leading six very technical people because you have the engineering ability, product instincts and judgment to make everyone around you more effective.</p> <p><strong>This is a builder's job, not a professional management job.</strong></p> <p>We're looking for someone who can make Telnyx a platform developers genuinely love building on, and turn that into a meaningful business.</p> <h6><span style="font-weight: 400;">#LI-RH1</span></h6><div class="content-conclusion"><p> </p> <p> </p></div>

About Us:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

About the role

We're looking for a Customer Trust Specialist to join our London office and help run the customer-facing side of our trust program. Where our GRC team keeps the compliance engine running behind the scenes, you'll be one of the people customers actually interact with, turning our security, privacy, and AI-governance posture into accurate answers that earn trust. You'll handle security questionnaires end to end, help operate our trust automation platform, and support customer conversations across EMEA and beyond. This is a great fit for someone with solid security-review experience who wants to grow their scope at a fast-scaling AI company.

What you'll do

  • Handle security questionnaires end to end: intake, drafting, review, and delivery for customer security assessments, RFPs, and vendor evaluations, in whatever format they arrive (OneTrust, spreadsheets, portals, email), pulling in Security, Legal, or Engineering when an answer needs it.

  • Operate our trust automation platform: use and help improve the system that generates answers from our governed knowledge base. Review output for accuracy, flag weak or incorrect answers, and help keep the guardrails from over-claiming.

  • Keep the knowledge base current: update answers as the platform, certifications, and control environment change; ingest new evidence (SOC 2, ISO 27001/27701/42001, HIPAA, penetration tests); and flag stale facts before they reach a customer.

  • Handle one-off customer requests: evidence requests, Trust Center access, point questions from account teams, and anything that doesn't fit a questionnaire but still shapes a customer's confidence.

  • Support customer calls: join prospect and customer calls alongside Sales and Solutions to field security, privacy, and AI-safety questions, especially for UK and EMEA customers. Partner with the sales team from intake through close.

  • Support contract reviews: work with Legal and Deal Desk on security and privacy terms in DPAs and MSAs, including UK GDPR and EU data-transfer questions; learn which positions are standard and which need escalation.

  • Keep the program honest: follow the standing rules that protect us and our customers: state only our standard position, never reference another customer's ask or situation, and escalate anything that needs Legal, Security, or Engineering sign-off.

  • Track program data: log knowledge-base gaps, recurring questions we can't answer well yet, and where automation is saving or costing time, and share findings with the team.

  • Help maintain public trust artifacts: keep the Trust Center, security whitepapers, and supporting evidence current and aligned with what we actually do.

How the role will grow

As you build context on our platform and customers, you'll take on more ownership:

  • Broader program ownership: lead specific parts of the program, such as a framework area, a slice of the knowledge base, or EMEA customer coverage.

  • AI-assurance coverage: help extend the knowledge base to emerging standards like ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF, and the EU AI Act.

  • Cross-functional influence: work more closely with Product, Engineering, Legal, and Sales to make our security and AI-safety posture a differentiator rather than a checkbox.

Your impact

You will ensure that every study is delivered on time, within budget and to the expected quality standards, while keeping the team’s workload manageable.   • Ensure quality and compliance: maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), templates and tools; prepare for audits and inspections; and ensure compliance with GCP, ICH guidelines, the French Jardé law and GDPR.

  • Your team: five to six people—Senior Clinical Trial Managers, Clinical Trial Managers and CRAs—who each manage their projects end to end across several therapeutic areas.

    Work from anywhere, impact everywhere 

    Diversity is at the heart of who we are at Xapo Bank.
    We're a fully distributed team of over 160 Xapiens that work remotely from 50+ countries around the world.

    Our beginning: A world that enjoys economic freedom and wealth protection,no matter where you live or who is running your country.
    To achieve that, we search the world for the best people for the job.
    We work hard, think globally, and inspire each other to learn and grow.
    We are committed to changing the way things are done.

    Although we are headquartered in Gibraltar, this is a full time, 100% remote position 
    Work from anywhere!

    Position overview

    Xapo's product suite has grown from a Bitcoin vault into a full member proposition: BTC and USD accounts that pay interest, a global card with Bitcoin cashback, Bitcoin-backed loans, a growing suite of BTC wealth and credit products, and access to stocks, ETFs, and stablecoins, all inside one regulated relationship. 

    Xapo is a bank, and a bank earns on the money its members choose to hold with it. Each of those products shipped well. What hasn't yet existed is a single owner of the economics of the customer relationship: one person accountable for winning the right members, growing what they hold with us, and keeping them, and for the balance-sheet products that make that possible.

    The Chief Customer Officer is a new role at the top of the house, reporting to the CEO. You will run the stream that grows what members hold with Xapo, and you will own the Customer P&L, retail and institutional. It brings growth, client coverage, product management, and product design under one leader who is judged on customer contribution, the assets attracted and kept, and the members who stay. This is a customer-focused role in the most commercial sense: what a member earns from us, not the feature we shipped, is the centre of every decision.

    The measure of success is a Customer P&L that grows on what members hold and keep: LTV:CAC improving, approved-to-paid rising, churn falling, and customer contribution the business can plan against.

    This is a banking role, not a requirements-gathering role, a marketing role, or a role you can run from a dashboard. Products are priced on the balance sheet and judged on the money they attract and keep.

    The mandate

    1. Own the Customer P&L, retail and institutional.
      You own customer contribution: customer gross profit from what members' balances earn, secured lending, Bitcoin yield, and conversion, stocks and ETFs, less the cost of winning and keeping members. We earn on what members hold, not on what they tap, send, or click, so you run on assets held and the margin they earn, not payment volume. Good looks like a Customer P&L the Exco and Board can plan against, where every line has a number you own and can explain, up or down.
    2. Grow what members hold with us, through earning products run like a banker would.
      You own the roadmap for the balance-sheet products: deposits and savings, lending and credit, and trading and structured. Each is led by a mission PM who is a banker, owning a product's contribution and its price on the balance sheet, not a backlog. Requirements go through the gate; the economics are the job. Every item is priced by Finance before it is built, on a shared risk appetite with Risk and Treasury. Good looks like products that scale assets held and member lifetime value at a risk profile the Board actually approved.
    3. Win the right members, efficiently.
      You own Growth: audience, lifecycle, and content, with one head accountable for the path from approval to paid. You own CAC and approved-to-paid, find the members who bring other members, and activate them in week one. Every incentive is priced before it runs. Good looks like net paid-member growth that improves every quarter, at a CAC that LTV comfortably justifies, because you diagnosed where the funnel leaks rather than spending more to fill it.
    4. Keep members, and deepen the relationship with the ones who hold balances.
      Retention is the most efficient growth we have. You own churn, and you own Client Coverage: relationship managers who sell the missions' products to the members who hold balances, and loop demand back into the roadmap. You are accountable for net new AUM flow, covered-book retention, and products per covered member, and for growth that is broad-based rather than concentrated in a few accounts. Good looks like falling churn and AUM growth from members who stay and expand rather than members re-acquired at cost.
    5. Make the value of Xapo visible, and the experience effortless.
      You own Product Design: one design system and one shell, so that members see the value of what they are earning clearly and early, and find every task simple. You design the proposition in the stream with Finance and partner with Operations, who run onboarding, KYC, support, cards, and payments, to remove friction at the points that affect members most. Good looks like members who understand their return, complete what they set out to do, and stay.
    6. Build one Customer organisation, not four.
      Growth, Client Coverage, Mission PMs, and Product Design come together under one operating model: one set of key results read weekly from one source, shared frameworks for discovery and prioritisation, and real career paths for the people in it. Engineering is pulled to a single ranked roadmap, and nobody in your line has engineers of their own. Good looks like fewer hand-offs per outcome and a number for every cell that its owner explains every week.
    7. Bring the regulated-bank and crypto-native lens to every customer call.
      You understand that a KYC onboarding decision and an AML monitoring decision carry different risk appetites, that a false positive at the gate is a paid-for member lost, and that a proposition built for a crypto-native power user can still fail a first-time bank customer.     EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications.     • Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports

    Wil jij bouwen aan de vastgoedopgave én aan een nieuwe ontwikkelorganisatie? Als ervaren ontwikkelaar bij Dura Vermeer Bouw & Vastgoed werk je aan grootschalige vastgoedprojecten in Midden-Nederland. Je stapt in na acquisitie en bent verantwoordelijk voor de verdere ontwikkeling richting verkoop en realisatie. In een ondernemende omgeving krijg je alle ruimte om mee te bouwen aan het team, je expertise in te zetten in de samenwerking met adviseurs én door te groeien naar een rol met meer inhoudelijke en coachende verantwoordelijkheid.

     

    Dit wordt jouw baan

    Ondernemend, ervaren en klaar om impact te maken? Dan voel jij je thuis binnen deze nieuwe ontwikkelorganisatie van Dura Vermeer. Als senior Projectontwikkelaar werk je aan omvangrijke vastgoedprojecten en help je niet alleen projecten verder te brengen, maar ook het team en de organisatie.     Wat ga je doen
    De focus ligt op het moment waarop een tender is gewonnen of een acquisitie is verworven en projecten daadwerkelijk ontwikkeld gaan worden.     Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis.

    Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent iconisch én dichtbij en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken.

    Bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Utrecht staan we aan het begin van een nieuw hoofdstuk. Naast renovatie en transformatie realiseren we nu ook nieuwbouwprojecten in de woning- en utiliteitsbouw én zetten we de volgende stap naar eigen gebieds- en vastgoedontwikkeling.

Met ruim 100 collega's binnen onze werkmaatschappij bouwen we niet alleen aan duurzame woningen, utiliteitsprojecten en leefomgevingen, maar ook aan de toekomst van onze eigen organisatie. De lijnen zijn kort, de ambities groot en de kansen om mee te bouwen aan nieuwe werkwijzen, teams en projecten liggen voor het oprapen.

    Stage communicatie bouwplaatsprotocol

    Locatie: Haaften | 32–40 uur | Start: februari, maar mag ook per direct!

    Wat jij tijdens je stage maakt wordt straks écht gebruikt op onze bouwplaatsen

    Hoe ziet een goed ingerichte bouwplaats eruit? Waar hoort de bewegwijzering? Welke uitstraling geven we bouwhekdoeken? Hoe maken we duidelijk wat de standaard is voor veiligheid, afval, parkeren of bezoekers? En vooral: hoe zorg je dat een uitvoerder niet eindeloos hoeft te zoeken, maar in één oogopslag weet wat nodig is en welk materieel daarbij hoort?

    Dat willen we bij Dura Vermeer vastleggen in één Bouwplaatsprotocol: een praktische handleiding én visuele standaard voor de bouwplaats. Het laat zien hoe we onze bouwplaatsen herkenbaar, netjes, veilig en slim inrichten. En dat protocol ga jij helpen maken.

    Dit maakt deze stage interessant:

    Je zit tijdens deze stage precies tussen communicatie, ontwerp en de praktijk van de bouw in. De ene dag praat je met een uitvoerder over wat er wel en niet werkt. De volgende dag orden je alle informatie die al binnen Dura Vermeer beschikbaar is. Daarna schrijf je een richtlijn zo dat iemand hem in een paar seconden begrijpt en zet je die in Adobe InDesign om in een pagina die ook visueel klopt.

    Je hoeft dus niet te kiezen tussen schrijven of ontwerpen. Je doet allebei.

    Dit ga je doen:

    • bestaande richtlijnen en informatie binnen Dura Vermeer verzamelen en structureren;

    • bekijken hoe bouwplaatsen nu worden ingericht en waar collega's in de praktijk tegenaan lopen;

    • praten met uitvoerders en collega’s binnen Dura Vermeer Materieel;

    • bepalen welke onderwerpen, standaarden en middelen in het Dura Vermeer-protocol thuishoren;

    • foto's, illustraties, iconen, tabellen en andere visuele middelen maken en inzetten om informatie snel duidelijk te maken;

    • waar nodig nieuwe communicatiemiddelen of formats ontwikkelen;

    • het complete protocol vormgeven in de huisstijl van Dura Vermeer;

    • kritisch testen of iemand op de bouwplaats er ook daadwerkelijk snel mee kan werken en het protocol op basis van deze feedback verbeteren.

    Je krijgt veel vrijheid om na te denken over vragen als: hoe maken we een document van deze omvang prettig om te gebruiken? Wat moet je laten zien in plaats van uitleggen? Welke informatie hoort bij elkaar? Welke dingen helpen een uitvoerder echt verder?


    Wat breng jij mee

    Voor deze opdracht zoeken we niet alleen iemand die mooi kan vormgeven. En ook niet alleen iemand die goed kan schrijven. Juist de combinatie is belangrijk.

    Jij:

    • vindt het leuk om veel informatie terug te brengen tot een logische structuur. Je kunt een technisch verhaal begrijpelijk opschrijven en hebt tegelijkertijd oog voor typografie, beeld, hiërarchie en vormgeving;

    • volgt een hbo-opleiding zoals Communicatie, Creative Business, Communication & Multimedia Design (CMD), Media & Design, Crossmedia Design, Marketingcommunicatie, Visual Communication/Graphic Design of een vergelijkbare opleiding;

    • schrijft helder en foutloos Nederlands;

    Build with us

    Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.

    Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow, with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable.

    With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions.

    We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of.

    Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.

    Your impact

    Credit, IRRBB and capital models sit at the heart of how a bank measures its own risk. Mollie already uses models in day to day processes, but nobody challenges them independently from a second line perspective yet. As Model Risk Officer, you'll help build the second line model risk function that gives Mollie, and its regulator, confidence that models can be trusted before they're used.

    This is a true 0 to 1 role. Mollie isn't a bank today, so there's no model risk framework, validation methodology or model inventory to inherit. You'll design the policy, validation approach and governance from scratch, starting with the credit, IRRBB and capital models already in design for our future capital and liquidity planning. Your work feeds into our licence application and, once authorised, into how we manage model risk every day.

    You'll also work with our Machine Learning team and the Domains already deploying models, so you can shape how we manage model risk today, not just in a banking future. Your challenge and sign off will be visible to senior leadership, audit and, eventually, our regulator. As Mollie grows and matures its model risk management, your scope grows from building the framework to running an ongoing model risk cycle.

    What you'll ship

    • Build and own Mollie's model risk management framework and policy, including model risk appetite, validation standards and the model risk lifecycle.

    • Set up and maintain the model inventory for credit, IRRBB and capital models, with materiality and risk tiering for each.

    • Coordinate independent second line validation and challenge before models are used, including credit risk and ECL, IRRBB, and Pillar 1 and Pillar 2 capital models.

    • Design the ongoing monitoring and re-validation cycle with the Machine Learning team, covering performance testing, limitation tracking and re-validation triggers.

    • Partner with model owners in Credit Risk and Treasury ALM, and coordinate within the second line Risk function, so model risk challenge is built into the wider risk and capital frameworks.

    • Coordinate clear, well documented validation reports and model risk information that stand up to scrutiny from DNB/ECB, external auditors and internal audit.

    What you'll bring

    • Around 5 to 7 years of experience in model risk management or model validation within a bank, preferably across at least one of credit, IRRBB and capital models.

    • Solid working knowledge of ECB model risk expectations and how model validation should be structured and evidenced.

    • Comfort building a model risk framework and validation approach from the ground up. You're excited to write the first playbook.

    • Strong quantitative skills to critically assess model methodology, assumptions and performance, and the discipline to document your findings so others, including a regulator, can follow them.

    • The ability to explain model limitations and validation findings to model owners and senior stakeholders, and the confidence to hold your ground under challenge.

    • Genuine curiosity about how AI can speed up the parts of model validation that don't need a human, so more of your time goes toward judgement and challenge.

    Grow your way

    At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

    You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

    No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

    Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy

    If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.

    Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like.

    AI at Mollie

    We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day.

    AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Abgeschlossene IT-Ausbildung, z. B. als Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration, IT-Systemelektroniker oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Die Rolle ist bewusst für erfahrene IT-Fachkräfte mit Bezug zum Gesundheitswesen vorgesehen und nicht als Quereinstieg konzipiert.

  • Weil funktionierende IT im Gesundheitswesen entscheidend dafür ist, dass Praxen sich auf das konzentrieren können, worauf es wirklich ankommt: ihre Patient.

  • Gesund und gestärkt durch den Tag: Für dein Wohlbefinden sorgen Getränke, frisches Obst, eine Müslibar und leckere Speisen aus unserer firmeneigenen Kantine.
  • Für dich und deine Liebsten: Kinder in liebevollen Händen in unserer betriebseigenen Kita (#Hasokids) und Hunde sind auch willkommen -----
  • Weitere Benefits: Corporate Benefits, Job Bikes und ein nachhaltiges betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement mit spannenden Screenings, Kursen und Trainings.

Klingt nach deinem nächsten Schritt?

Dann bring dein IT-Know-how dort ein, wo zuverlässige Systeme jeden Tag einen Unterschied machen. Werde Teil von TI4HEALTH und sorge gemeinsam mit uns dafür, dass unsere Kund:innen technisch sicher durch ihren Praxisalltag kommen.

Wir freuen uns auf dich!

Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

You will play a key role in delivering Kraken's Human Design principles and Operating Model to transform our clients Operations, leading implementation through a hands-on, consultative approach. A strong understanding of Human Design principles and change management best practice is essential, as is the ability to influence leaders, navigate change with confidence and bring sharp project management and analytical skills.

 

You are responsible for guiding clients through the Kraken migration framework (BOT method), mentoring internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring operational success and long-term sustainability of the target operating model. 

 

While operations will be your core focus, you’ll also need a solid grasp of broader retail functions – how data, comms and marketing interact with operations to shape customer outcomes and influence the success of the new model. While the primary focus is the C&I function, you’ll also need B2C experience to effectively support clients across the portfolio.

 

When executed well, these transformations can feel truly magical – across the whole organisation, and most importantly, our clients’ customers. The SCDL role is to make sure that magic is felt.

Key Responsibilities: what you'll do

  • Consultative Leadership & Client Engagement:

  • Lead client interactions through the entire BOT program lifecycle, providing hands-on consulting and fostering a learning environment by guiding clients to take ownership early in the migration process of the operational programme.

  • Help mobilise and set up initiatives such as Operations Transformation Office (OTO - client’s internal change management team), Early Adopters and work closely with Kraken’s Tech Teams to enable a smooth transformation.

  • Establish strong relationships within the client’s Senior Leadership team, acting as a trusted advisor and helping to shape, influence and unblock strategic decisions.

  • Empower the client’s migration ‘Ambassadors’ to become champions of the model, ensuring the program’s long term adoption and accountability across the organisation.

  • Shape planning so it aligns with the client’s goals and aspirations.

 

Project Management:

  • Guide the delivery of Kraken programmes – from Leadership Development to Skills Based Learning – by defining clear programme milestones that keep teams and stakeholders on track and organised.

  • Partner tightly with internal Tech teams so operational and technical migrations run in lockstep, reducing friction and keeping delivery on track.

  • Drive continuous improvement and iteration, tailoring solutions based on client-specific needs.

 

Mentorship & Coaching:

  • Cultivate future leadership by mentoring and coaching the client’s OTO and internal teams, enabling them to be successful in a Kraken powered organisation.

  • Ensure that internal stakeholders, including the OTO team, are fully equipped to take over ownership of scaling the operational transformation, with formalised check-ins at agreed points. Support the creation of high performing teams, able to think, lead and problem solve and lead in keeping with agile, customer centric methodologies.

 

Analytical & Problem-Solving:

  • Utilise strong analytical skills to anticipate challenges, pre-empt pain points and intervene early on to course correct.

  • Leverage client and Kraken data to identify red flags, understand cause-and-effect relationships, and drive corrective actions to improve client outcomes.

  • Being able to correlate and articulate the connection between employee engagement and customer satisfaction, and how operational changes can impact cost to serve.

 

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Influence:

  • Collaborate with multiple teams and stakeholders both within Kraken and across client internal teams such as HR, Data, Marketing and  Tech to provide clear guidance on program delivery and solutions while managing client expectations.

  • Collaborate across departments to ensure that Kraken’s core offering aligns with client expectations. Ensure that operations never become a blocker to continued migration.

  • Remain up to date with new features and products and ensure the client is trained and adopts new functionality.

 

Driving Organisational Change:

  • Lead cultural and operational transformations, embedding sustainable change within the client’s organisation, using Kraken’s Human Design approach.

  • Champion the Kraken Operating model, ensuring the client’s operational structure evolves in alignment with best practices for both immediate and long-term success.

Skills: what you'll have

  • Exceptional project management skills, with the ability to work across multiple clients and fast-paced timelines.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify risks, and proactively implement solutions.

  • Proven influencing skills, with experience persuading senior leaders and driving adoption of new methodologies.

  • Deep technical understanding of Kraken's products and services, including migration processes and temporary solutions.

  • Demonstrating leadership practices and promoting professionalism in client interactions Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain complex concepts and principles to a varied audience.

 

Experience

  • Proven communication at all levels, able to leverage style at Exec level.

  • Exposure to outsourcing models (BPOs), understanding their drivers, challenges, and how to manage these relationships effectively.

  • Change management using agile methodologies.

  • Proven record of creating high performing teams, either internally within operations or externally with clients. 

 

Other Requirements:

  • Ability to travel globally, with placement based on preference when possible, but flexibility required according to client needs.

  • Ability to work across multiple clients and markets, quickly adapting to varying client needs and environments/languages.

  • Highly driven to ‘make things happen’. Growth mindset demonstrated through all your work. Ability to speak persuasively and inspire energy, motivating both internal teams and external stakeholders including Direct Reports.

  • Comfortable navigating between operations and technical conversations, bridging gaps between business needs and technical solutions.

  • Expertise in driving programme ownership, from inception through to sustainable execution, ensuring clients are equipped to lead post-migration.

  • Fluent Danish & German is a prerequisite for this role

Who are we

At Lokalise, we make it easy and profitable for businesses to expand into new markets. Our AI-powered localization platform helps companies manage both software and marketing content from a single, unified environment — ensuring every team speaks with one voice across every language and channel.

By automating workflows, integrating with over 60 tools, and centralizing translation memory and terminology, Lokalise enables product, engineering, and marketing teams to collaborate without friction and launch globally up to 10× faster and at 80% lower cost.

Trusted by thousands of businesses across more than 100 countries, Lokalise empowers millions of people worldwide to use digital services in their native languages. Backed by a customer-loved support team, our platform fits seamlessly into your design, development, and content workflows, helping you scale with consistency and control.

Location

While our company operates exclusively on a remote basis, you must reside and have the legal right to work in one of the following countries: the United Kingdom, Latvia, or Spain.

This is a full-time, remote position. Please note that we do not engage on a B2B or contractor basis.

 

About the Team

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a cross-functional team in our Product Engineering organization. Each of our engineering teams owns a product domain at Lokalise, from vision to delivery. Teams talk to customers, find out what they need, set their own goals and choose how to solve the problems that matter most.

AI is already part of how we build software at Lokalise, and it's changing what great engineering leadership looks like. We're looking for a leader who stays close to the work and understands how AI is changing speed, quality and engineers' day-to-day experience. You'll keep your teams focused on outcomes that matter to our customers and our business, not just on how much gets shipped.

For this role, you'll lead our Editing Experience team. The team owns the tools linguists and reviewers use every day to translate, review and approve content at scale: the translation editor, the review and approval workflow, content management tools and the developer utilities that support them. Together with your Product Manager and Designer, you'll own the team's strategy and delivery end to end.

 

What You Will Do

  • Lead, coach and develop your teams of Software Engineers. You'll support their career growth, run performance evaluations, contribute to compensation planning and hire engineers who raise the bar.
  • Stay technically close to the work without becoming a bottleneck. You'll review key designs and pull requests, pair with engineers on tricky problems and take on contributions outside the critical path (such as tooling, prototypes or small fixes). This keeps you in touch with the codebase and your teams' daily reality while they own delivery.
  • Partner with Product Managers and Designers (the Product Triad) to understand our customers deeply and take part in discovery. You'll make sure your teams work on the right problems, putting outcomes ahead of outputs.

About the role:

Samsara's UK Enterprise business is one of our fastest-growing segments globally. About us

Tweag is a software consultancy that helps engineering organizations overcome technical bottlenecks that stand in the way of success. Our work in scalable build systems, primarily through Bazel, helps our clients grow their tech organization without the maintenance burden.

About you

Tweag works with organizations at all experience levels, from trying out Bazel for the first time, to refactoring and scaling Bazel workspaces with hundreds of thousands of potential targets. In every situation, we are the experts, helping them achieve their goals and delighting them with improvements they never expected.

We are looking for someone who can handle:

  • Integration with as-yet-unsupported languages.
  • Development of specialized Bazel toolchains.
  • Improving open-source Bazel rules to unblock our clients.
  • Using Gazelle to standardize and clean up code.
  • Refactoring Bazel code, and teaching others how to do so.
  • Debugging the internals of Bazel.

In addition, we'd appreciate

  • Ties to the Bazel community.
  • Active maintenance of Bazel open-source tools.
  • Expertise in Bazel performance optimization, both within rules and in evaluating the build graph.
  • Knowledge of other reproducible build systems, such as Nix, Buck2, or Pants.

You'll love Tweag if you love

  • A fully remote workplace with strong respect for work-life balance.

Joko helps millions of users earn cashback automatically, whether they shop online through affiliate links, activate coupons, or pay in-store with their linked bank card. About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the role

Every airframe Harmattan AI flies starts with a model. System identification turns flight data into the verified dynamics that guidance and control are designed, tuned and trained on. It is the foundation of an autopilot that adapts across multirotors, fixed wings, VTOLs and missiles.

As a System Identification Engineer, working out of Paris, you will own the path from flight test to identified model. You will design and run your own experiments, build a repeatable identification pipeline, and deliver models the G&C team can trust.

 

Responsibilities

  • Experiment Design & Flight Test: Plan and run your own identification tests, from excitation design to flight tests, including coordinating with the .

  • Model Identification: Identify rigid-body, aerodynamic, propulsion and actuator dynamics using frequency and time-domain methods, including closed-loop identification on vehicles flown under a controller.

  • Propulsion & Actuators: Characterize motors, ESCs, propellers and control surfaces, including bandwidth, delays, saturation, and thermal and battery effects.

  • Identification Pipeline: Build and maintain an automated, reproducible pipeline from flight logs to identified model. This covers ingestion, data-quality checks, estimation, validation and reporting.

  • Model Validation: Validate models against held-out flight data, quantify uncertainty, and make sure each model is fit for purpose: controller design, simulation, or training learned G&C.

  • New Airframes: Extend the capability from multirotors to control-surface multirotors, fixed wings, tail-sitters and missiles.

  • Simulation & G&C Support: Deliver models into simulation, SITL and HITL, and work closely with control, guidance and embedded engineers to close the loop between models and flight results.

  • Mentorship: Depending on seniority, support the team by mentoring junior engineers and interns.

 

Candidate Requirements

  • Educational Background: A strong academic record with a degree in aerospace, control, mechanical engineering or a related STEM field. A practical track record matters more than the specific degree.

  • System Identification: Proven experience identifying dynamic models of flying platforms from real data, in both the frequency and time domain, including the pitfalls of closed-loop data.

  • Flight Mechanics & Control: Solid grasp of rigid-body dynamics, aerodynamic forces and moments, non-dimensionalization, stability modes and propulsion models. Also enough control background to know what the model will be used for.

  • Flight Testing: Hands-on experience planning and running flight tests and working from raw, imperfect logs.

  • Software: Strong Python and scientific computing skills, with the discipline to build tools others can rerun.

Nice to have

  • Rigorous about data quality, uncertainty and validation; skeptical of models until they are proven.

  • Autonomous and hands-on, comfortable moving between bench, field and code.

  • Communicates clearly, able to present models and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders.

  • Thrives under pressure in a fast-paced environment with a no-task-is-too-small mentality.

  • Fixed-wing aerodynamic modeling; VTOL or tail-sitter dynamics; remote pilot certification; experience with real flight logs; structural or vibration modes; data-driven or learned dynamics models.

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI’s mission of providing a defensive edge to allied nations through ethical, high-impact technology.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

WHO YOU ARE

You are a commercial leader who has built the go-to-market of a platform from a blank page and knows what it takes to turn a product that people already use into a business that pays for itself. You are comfortable in a B2B2C world: the customer is reached through someone else's channel, the data belongs to the ecosystem, and the money comes from several ends of a transaction at once. You influence without authority, because the teams that execute will rarely report to you. You want to build something that reaches millions of small businesses, you are prepared to work for it.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Toqan for Partners is the AI assistant for the merchants across the companies of the Prosus ecosystem: restaurants, pharmacies, hotels, sellers, real estate agencies and car dealers, five million businesses in total. The next twelve months decide how it will become a business: which applications partners pay for and at what price, how value is shared with everyone the partner transacts with, how the uplift is measured and published so the next company embeds, and how the product travels from iFood to the rest of the ecosystem and to India and Europe. Structure the partnerships that carry the revenue

Lead the commercial agreements with distributors, industry, fintechs and the ecosystem companies' commercial platforms, from first conversation to signed terms, and the co-investment models that align their incentives with the partner's.

Build and lead the team

Hire and develop a small go-to-market and revenue team, growth on the merchant side, monetisation and analytics, and set its standard for rigour, ownership and candour.

    Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot

    Digitalisering verandert de manier waarop overheden en publieke organisaties werken, besluiten nemen en dienstverlening organiseren. Tegelijkertijd groeit de behoefte aan praktische oplossingen, toepasbare kennis en slimme instrumenten die organisaties helpen om complexe digitale vraagstukken beheersbaar te maken.

    Wil jij ervaring opdoen binnen een toonaangevend adviesbureau en bijdragen aan vraagstukken op het gebied van digitalisering, data, digitale autonomie en publieke innovatie? Dan is deze stage iets voor jou.

    Dit ga je doen

    Als stagiair(e) binnen het team Digitale Transformatie ondersteun je adviseurs bij uiteenlopende opdrachten voor ministeries, uitvoeringsorganisaties, provincies, gemeenten en andere maatschappelijke organisaties.

    Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

    • Ondersteunen bij onderzoeken, analyses en adviesopdrachten.

    • Voorbereiden en ondersteunen van workshops, werksessies en bijeenkomsten voor opdrachtgevers.

    • Meewerken aan de ontwikkeling van praktische handreikingen, methodieken en kennisproducten.

    • Uitwerken van onderzoeksresultaten naar concrete producten voor opdrachtgevers.

    • Actualiseren en verrijken van onze website, publicaties en online kennisproducten.

    • Structureren, actualiseren en verder ontwikkelen van bestaande kenniscollecties tot een deelbare kenniscatalogus.

    • Uitvoeren van markt- en deskresearch naar ontwikkelingen op het gebied van digitalisering, data en digitale autonomie.

    • Ondersteunen bij de doorontwikkeling van onze digitale-autonomie-quickscan en andere proposities.

    Afhankelijk van jouw interesses en achtergrond draai je bovendien mee in lopende adviesprojecten.

    Hier kom je terecht

    Berenschot is een zelfstandig en onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. We dragen bij aan vooruitgang in organisaties en de maatschappij met onze adviezen en oplossingen. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert. We streven altijd naar verrassende en vernieuwende oplossingen, wat ons uniek maakt. Met een open en informele cultuur, samenwerking tussen verschillende vakgebieden en veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid vanaf dag één,

    krijg je de kans om te ontdekken wat je belangrijk vindt, waar je kracht ligt en waarin jij je wilt ontwikkelen.

    Dit zijn je directe collega’s

    Je wordt onderdeel van het team Digitale Transformatie binnen de adviesgroep Openbaar Bestuur van Berenschot.

    Ons team ondersteunt organisaties bij vraagstukken rond digitale strategie, informatiehuishouding, digitale autonomie, datastrategie, cybersecurity en continuiteit, governance, dienstverlening en organisatieontwikkeling. Daarbij combineren we inhoudelijke kennis van technologie met inzicht in recht, bestuur, beleid en organisatie.

    Je werkt samen met adviseurs met uiteenlopende achtergronden, waaronder bestuurskunde, informatiemanagement, bedrijfskunde, data en technologie. Vanaf dag één krijg je verantwoordelijkheid en lever je een concrete bijdrage aan opdrachten en producten.

    Je volgt een hbo- of wo-opleiding op het snijvlak van data, digitalisering, IT en organisatievraagstukken, bijvoorbeeld informatiemanagement, business IT & management, digital business, data science & business, technische bedrijfskunde, bestuurskunde (met een focus op digitalisering), bedrijfskunde (met een focus op technologie of innovatie) of een vergelijkbare opleiding.

    Daarnaast:

    • Heb je affiniteit met digitalisering en maatschappelijke vraagstukken.

    • Ben je analytisch sterk en nieuwsgierig.

    • Werk je zelfstandig en gestructureerd.

    • Kun je complexe informatie helder opschrijven.

    • Vind je het leuk om kennis te ontwikkelen én praktisch toepasbaar te maken.

    • Een meewerkstage van 4 tot 6 maanden.

    • Startdatum januari/februari 2027.

    • Een marktconforme stagevergoeding van € 600,- per maand (op fulltimebasis).

    • Een laptop.

    • Flexibele werkmogelijkheden, ook thuis.

    • Persoonlijke begeleiding door een ervaren adviseur.

    • Een stimulerende en leerzame werkomgeving waarin ruimte is voor eigen inbreng.

    • De mogelijkheid om een netwerk op te bouwen binnen Berenschot en met bedrijven.

    • De mogelijkheid om in te stromen in het traineeship van Berenschot.

    Naast je stage kun je deelnemen aan het stageplusprogramma van Berenschot: een opleidingsprogramma van circa 3,5 maand dat trainingen biedt op het gebied van advieskennis, -vaardigheden en persoonlijke ontwikkeling.     Role - Software Engineer - Optimisation Team

    Company - iwell - Harmonizing Clean Energy

    Location - Utrecht


    About iwell

    At iwell, we are all about reinforcing energy security. We help European businesses become more energy independent. With growing regulations, extreme price volatility and rising grid issues, they need to be resilient. It is time to take charge and think ahead.

    We deliver energy management solutions that ensure that businesses are always in control of their energy. Our in-house developed EMS and modular battery storage drive profit through sustainability, making businesses future-proof. 

    We are a fast-growing international team of bold, talented individuals. From engineers and software developers to creative thinkers and customer-focused business developers. No matter what your strong suit is, we always are looking for people who are determined to make a positive impact.


    The Role

    The Optimisation team builds the Python applications that decide what our customers' energy assets should do, and when. Batteries, EV fleets, solar and grid connections all come together in our optimiser, and the team turns prices, forecasts and constraints into schedules and decisions that run in production every day.

    Much of this work has an operations-research flavour, and the problems rarely arrive neatly defined.. They arrive as a customer who needs their vans charged by 6:00 at the lowest cost or a battery whose value depends on the hour. We're looking for someone who is comfortable across that whole path: understanding the real-world problem, shaping it into something a computer can solve, and shipping and operating the result. You don't need to be an OR specialist. You do need to be a strong Python engineer who enjoys messy, concrete problems.

    Success in this role means being able to:

    • Take a loosely defined operational problem and turn it into working, maintainable production code.

    • Work with data and models (optimisation, forecasting or plain statistics) without losing sight of the engineering.

    What you will do

    • Create charging schedules for EV fleets that minimise electricity costs while guaranteeing every vehicle is ready when it needs to be. This means modelling tariffs, grid limits and departure times, and handling what happens when reality deviates from the plan.

    • Calculate the value of each kWh produced or consumed, so that batteries, solar and flexible loads are steered by what energy is actually worth at that moment, and customers can see where their savings come from.

    • Build forecasting models that predict operational issues before they happen, to maximise asset uptime and reduce the number of support tickets our Operations team has to handle.

    • Take your work all the way to production: packaging, deployment, monitoring and bugfixing.

    • Work with the rest of the Optimisation team on the shared tooling, data pipelines and modelling conventions the team uses..


    What are looking for

    • 5+ years of production Python development experience, writing clean, tested, maintainable code.

    • A proven ability to translate real-world problems into working code.

    • A pragmatic mindset: you choose the boring, well-understood solution when it's the right one, and you know when it isn't.

    • Strong communication skills and a habit of documenting your work. Fluency in English is required.

    • Weekly working hours of 32-40 hours 

    • Coming into the office 3-4 days per week


    Bonus points for

    None of these are required. We'd rather hire a strong engineer and teach the domain than the other way around.

    • Experience with a modelling library such as cvxpy or Pyomo, or other operations research experience..

    • Time-series forecasting in production, or basic MLOps: keeping models trained, monitored and honest.

    • Data analysis experience

    • Energy, battery or electricity domain knowledge: tariffs, grid constraints, day-ahead and imbalance markets.

    • The willingness to take on a People lead role in the team.


    Note: at iwell, we value growth potential over perfection. Feel free to respond if you can see yourself meeting this list in the (near) future.


    What we offer

    • A competitive salary within the range of EUR 4400-EUR6600 + 8% holiday allowance

    • 30 holidays per year, plus an annual company trip of 3 days

    • The opportunity to do volunteer work, by offering 1 volunteer day per year

    • Learning & Development budget of EUR 1,500 per year 

    • Attractive pension plan with Brand New Day 

    • Working remotely for 2 weeks per year 

    • We cover your travel costs, regardless of whether you come by bike, car, or public transport.

    • A mobile phone allowance of EUR 25 per month

    • Additional activities such as a bootcamp, volleyball tournament, company drinks etc.

    • iwell is a family-friendly company and employs many employees with care-taking responsibilities


    Interested?

    For more information about iwell, what we do, why we do it, and an overview of our partners, visit https://iwell.eu/.

    Our application process

    1. Apply. Our People & Culture Team and the hiring manager will review your application and will respond within 2 weeks.

    2. Phone screening. Are you a true iweller-in-the-making? We will invite you for an introductory call.

    3. Are you the one? You will have two interviews. For the second interview,, you will also be asked to work on a case.

    Acquisition based on this vacancy is not appreciated.

    At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.

    We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!

     

    Every day, physicians across The Netherlands lose hours to documentation instead of patients. Tandem gives that time back - and clinicians actually use it. That’s rare in health tech, and it changes the way you sell: you’re not convincing people they have a problem, you’re showing them a better way to work.

     

    We’re building the Dutch market properly - a real product with real pull, backed to win, and a sales team being built right now. If you want to contribute something being built for healthcare in the right way, this is the room to be in.

    About Tandem

     

    Tandem builds AI that gives time back to physicians, therapists and nurses. Our team of clinicians, psychologists and AI engineers builds close to the reality of care - pairing modern technology with medical expertise to cut administrative load and free up time for patients.

    • 200+ people, founded August 2023

    • $160m raised, backed by leading European VCs (EQT, Northzone, Kinnevik) and angels from companies like OpenAI

    • Product already live and in daily clinical use across Europe in +10,000 healthcare organisations (1500 in The Netherlands)

     

    About the role

    At Tandem Health, we’re building a clinician copilot that gives time back to care teams so clinicians can focus on patients. You'll be dealing with complex customers to win them over and expand our market share in the Netherlands.

     

    What you’ll do

    • Own the full cycle: qualify, demo, negotiate, close

    • Run a high throughput of meetings while keeping every conversation consultative, not transactional

    • Present the product to clinicians and decision-makers and translate their documentation pain into a clear reason to act

    • Manage relationships through to a live, happy customer, working closely with your SDR and MedOps

    • Stay engaged in your customer relationships long term, update and upsell them on new developments and features

    • Feed what you hear in the market back to product

    • Represent Tandem at events across the region

     

    What you bring

    • 5+ years of full-cycle B2B sales, previous experience in field sales, door-to-door prospecting, or territory-based commercial roles.

    • A track record of hitting and beating quota - and you can prove it with concrete numbers

    • The consultative, lead-from-the-front selling style described in “How we sell”

    • Native-level Dutch and C1/C2 English

    • Experience selling to healthcare professionals (clinics, private practices, care providers) or working in regulated environments.

    • Experience in digital products, SaaS, or technology that improves professional workflows.

     
     

    How we sell (our culture)

    We hire salespeople who lead, not ones who wait for a script:

Company Overview

Our client is a digital marketing agency that helps multi-location businesses with a physical presence turn strong in-person operations into online revenue. Its clients include med spas and aesthetics practices, clinics, OB/GYN practices, senior living communities, and dispensaries across the US and Canada. They usually have good operations and good reviews, and little online presence.

The agency is AI-native. It runs on Claude and on its own internal operating system and client portal. Anything digital is in scope, from search, SEO, and visibility in AI answers to websites, booking paths, reviews, social, paid media, branding, and fractional CMO support.

Your Role

This is a hands-on account manager role. You own a set of client accounts end to end, from the first proposal through onboarding and the months after. You write the brand messaging and copy yourself, drafting in Claude and editing until it sounds like the client, and you run SEO, social, and paid media directly, including conversion tracking and ad account structure.

Part of the job is building. You'll convert repeated tasks into Claude tools and workflows (briefs, content calendars, trackers) and improve how the team works. Clients in med spas and senior living are particular about tone and trust, so every AI draft gets edited and checked before a client sees it.

This role suits someone who wants the whole account rather than a single channel, and who's comfortable building parts of the process as they go. If you'd prefer to hand execution to a team once the plan is written, it probably isn't the right fit.

You'll

  • Onboard new accounts and get the site, tracking, and channels live in about two weeks

  • Confirm conversion tracking counts real bookings before budget moves

  • Write brand messaging, location pages, and client updates, drafted in Claude and edited by you

  • Run SEO, social, and paid media hands-on, including ad account structure

  • Structure multi-location accounts so each location's numbers read clearly, then compare cost per booked appointment and shift budget

  • Convert repeated tasks into Claude workflows the team uses every week

  • Join client calls, including some in other time zones

You Bring

  • 5+ years of current, hands-on digital marketing for clients, at an agency or your own practice

  • Technical grounding in conversion tracking, tags, ad account structure, or launching sites

  • Daily use of Claude and the tools that connect to it, plus something you've built with them

  • Near-native English for client calls and written updates

  • Experience running several client accounts at once, often with multiple locations

  • Brand and copy judgment you can explain and defend

  • Comfort working with minimal oversight

Bonus Points

  • Claude Code projects

  • A strong portfolio of client work

  • Published work or a personal brand, such as a course or newsletter

  • Clients in aesthetics, healthcare, senior care, or regulated retail

  • A technical degree in computer science, BI, or data analytics

What's Offered

  • Fully remote, full-time contractor role from LATAM

  • Working hours on US Central time, with some flexibility for client calls in other time zones

  • Paid in USD as a contractor. Share the range that fits your level and we'll go from there

  • Unlimited PTO, and you choose which holidays you observe

  • Scope and responsibility that grow as the agency grows

Interview Process

1️⃣ First Call: A 30-minute conversation with atomic✳HR
2️⃣ First Team Interview: Your first interview with the team
3️⃣ Second Team Interview: A second interview with the team

Redwood Finance Automation Solution Designer, Ireland

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Ireland. Day rate: EUR 450 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its finance operations on Redwood Finance Automation. The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, account reconciliation, journal processing and the reporting that follows, all connected to the organisation's ERP.

You will own the solution design. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineering team can build. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real.

What you will work on

Current-state analysis of the record-to-report processes with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design across close, reconciliation, journals and intercompany, written up as the solution design. Decisions on what standard Redwood capability covers and where an extension is justified. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems. Balance sheet auto-certification rules, controls, approvals and audit trail designed into the solution, so the automated close stands up to audit. Guidance to the engineers through build, and review of what they deliver against the design. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users. A roadmap for the next waves of automation once the first processes are live.

What you bring

Solution design ownership on at least one live Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance) implementation, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. 8 or more years in finance transformation, finance systems or record-to-report process design. A working understanding of SAP FI/CO, or the Oracle equivalent, and how close and reconciliation data flows between the ERP and the automation layer. Experience running workshops with finance users and turning what they say into a design that can be built and tested. The standing to work with senior finance stakeholders and hold a design position when it is challenged.

Useful but not essential:

Hands-on build experience on Redwood, so you know what your design asks of the engineers. BlackLine, Trintech, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. A finance qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or similar). Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood implementation: the finance processes in scope, the ERP it connected to, and which design decisions were yours.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood Finance Automation people in front of the client.

Job Title: Professional Programs Coordinator

Location: Remote

Reports to:Sr. Director, Professional Programs

WHO WE ARE

Fueled by passion and urgency, National Kidney Foundation is a lifeline for all people affected by kidney disease. As pioneers of scientific research and innovation, NKF focuses on the whole patient through the lens of kidney health. Relentless in our work, we enhance lives through action, education, and accelerating change.

NKF’s Mission is what we do, our Values are how we do it.

· Collaboration-Work as a team

· Community-Build stronger community
